description: a thin young woman with long straight black hair in a deep navy blue robe down to the feet patterned with small silver constellations, a silver crescent moon emblem on the chest, a high stiff collar, a dark wooden staff topped with a black crystal held upright in the front hand, no sparkles, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
